question: この設計から実装へ進んでよいか。
description: Reviews a design before implementation proceeds from it. Boundary, traceability, risk register and validation plan are judged on the design itself; the cross-checks against requirements, plan and code are what keep the judgment from becoming a single all-in-one upstream verdict, which is a Non-goal of #2017.
subject: design

baseline.description: A design is judged against the requirements it must satisfy rather than against a previous design, so this Flow declares no compare-baseline step.

evidence.description: The design is the subject; without it the run stops with DETERMINISTIC_UNRUNNABLE.
Absent requirements remove the design-versus-requirement cross-check; the design-internal review still runs and the degradation is recorded.
Absent plan skips the design-versus-plan cross-check and records the reason.
Absent code skips the design-versus-code cross-check and records the reason.
